race.comment: TEARDROP ROTATION (5) worked home well but couldn't quite break into the placings last start over 1250m at Morphettville Parks. Only goes up 1kg after the claim in an easier race. The winner of three from five at 1400m and at the third run back should be striking peak form. THERMODYNAMIC (10) cruised to victory over this distance at the Parks track two back. Stepped up to 1514m last time and while not far away was less impressive. Blinkers back on for the fourth run back. This sets up very nicely. DIRTY OLD TOWN (3) shouldered 59kgs to a tough win over this trip at Morphettville Parks a fortnight ago. Unbeaten at this distance and with the claim she gets in favourably. CHAKADO (1) returned from a six-month spell with a dominant all-the-way win over 1300m four weeks ago. Will roll forward and give them something to catch again.
